# Pinned build front-end for release.yml.
#
# WHY THIS FILE EXISTS. release.yml ran `python -m pip install --upgrade build`
# — not merely an unbounded floor but an instruction to take the newest thing
# on the index, on the one workflow whose output is the artefact a customer
# installs. The wheels for reeflex-claude / reeflex-holds / reeflex-mcp are
# built by whatever `build` happened to be published that morning.
#
# BOUND, justified by the surface release.yml uses: `python -m build --outdir
# <dir> <project>`, i.e. the PEP 517 front-end CLI. That CLI is the 1.x
# interface (latest 1.6.0, 2026-08-27); a 2.0 would be free to change it.
#
# NOTE, said plainly: release.yml runs only on a tag push, so this pin is NOT
# exercised by any PR's CI. It is bounded on reasoning, and the first tag cut
# after it lands is what proves it.
build>=1.2,<2
